newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Malaysian investor buys Seafresh stake.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian investor buys Seafresh stake.

text.p: A Malaysian investor has acquired a stake of approximately eight percent in listed fishing company Seafresh NZ Ltd, the company said on Wednesday.

The new shareholder bought 5.37 million shares at NZ$0.35 per share. The stake includes 2.88 million shares from the majority shareholder, Lim Family Holdings, with the balance from new shares issued by the company.

Lim Family spokesman Lee Lim said the company was delighted to have completed its planned selldown of shares to meet the New Zealand Stock Exchange's listing requirements for major shareholders to hold more than 75 percent of the company.
